SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kirino-chan, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I, like Kyou-chan more than, Japanese sweets...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huuuh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Even if I couldn't eat Japanese sweets for the rest of my life, that's fine! That's how much I like Kyou-chan...!

TEXT: [FI] ...I see. Then there's nothing more I have to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kirino-chan...

TEXT: [FI] I'll go get manjuu in the storefront. You two talk it out until I get back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] It's your problem and it was to begin with. It doesn't even concern me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...I only dealt with it because you said "Life counseling". I've repaid my debt. See ya.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...And she's gone.
[FI] So now, Manami and I are here, together... alone...
[FI] ...This is awkward.
[FI] Awkward but... I'll have to manage somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Say Manami, I know I came over here all of a sudden, but will you listen to what I have to say?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I said something awful to you. "Become the future Manami".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] When I told Kirino, she got really mad.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I... see...  And then, Kirino-chan came here and...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even so, you and me, never changed. Those are the words I thought about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It was just so nice and comfortable, I thought... if only it could be like that forever...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, Kirino told me and I finally realized I asked you to change for my sake.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm in no place to impose on you with my request. I should change myself as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I was just trying to force my own ideals on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] T-That's not true...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Because you were crying... right? That day we talked in the park...
[FI] At that time, I might have made a mistake and shrugged it off, but now seeing Manami on the verge of tears, I'm convinced that can only be it.
[FI] With my own ego, I hurt my dear childhood friend, I made her cry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Everything, it was all my fault. I'm really sorry!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ky-Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, listen to me a little longer!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For always being considerate towards me, thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...
[FI] Just apologizing isn't sincere. There's something I noticed about what Kirino told me.
[FI] Despite always causing trouble for Manami, I never actually thanked her in a proper manner.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's so obvious that I actually never realized it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You being by my side, I realized it's something I'm really grateful for.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Just like Kirino said, I'm an idiot, and I might also be thickheaded but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Stay by my side from now on as well and let me continue expressing my gratitude.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ky-Kyou-chan...
[FI] Manami's eyes glistened... was she moved by what I said...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Atchou!
[FI] What a grand sneeze.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Awww... nnngg, *sniffle*

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] K-Kyou-chan, sorry... I couldn't hold it back anymore...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Ah... don't...
[FI] M-My once in a lifetime confession... With a sneeze...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wait, are you actually sick?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes. It seems like I caught a summer cold.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] But, I did tell Kyou-chan that I caught a cold right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You did but...
[FI] Skipping school like that, of course I'd think you were faking it!
[FI] So that means... So far, that red face... Those teary eyes...
[FI] All of it... Was because of her cold!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] HAAAAAAaaaahhhh...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] W-What's wrong? You suddenly resemble an old man, Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm just worn out...
[FI] Whose fault is it... Goes without saying.
[FI] Though only half of it, feels like my just desserts.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] About what you said earlier...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I... can't stay by your side now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? W-Why!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Well, because, you'd catch my cold～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah... That's what you meant...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Oh... My chest's hurting, and my head is going *boom*.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] A cold, where I can only think about Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Manami? That means...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan... doesn't have to change～

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] No matter what kind of Kyou-chan it is, I'll properly look after him!
[FI] Seriously... She's a lost cause!
[FI] Really, that girl's problem is, she's not happy if she can't look after me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, I'll also be by your side!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This "Clueless" cold of yours, give it to me!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No problem, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe... Stupid Kyou-chan.
[FI] It feels like the mood has lightened.
[FI] Yes, this is the usual "warmth" between Manami and me. The mood that I wanted to last forever.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, let's get along from now on as well!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah! Same here, let's get along even as we grow old!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? U-Until we grow old... That's... Errr...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that a no?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] N-No! Kyou-chan... Let's always... Always get along!
